expectedText: Is your appointment still on Thursday, Leo? Yes, at two forty in the afternoon. I checked it this morning because I had written down two different times. Where is the reception desk in that building? It is beside the green entrance. The patient form is available there, and I can ask them to check the spelling of my name. Have you prepared your questions? I have a small list. I want to describe a cough, a sore throat and a headache. I will not guess a temperature or say I have a fever if I have not measured it. Good. What about the pain you mentioned yesterday? I will describe where it is and when I first noticed it. I also wrote down a question about my stomach. The nurse can ask for any other information during the examination. Is there a place to ask about a prescription?
